market_holds: Spot $0.4194 at the 2026-11-18 close (sealed baseline), an all-time low. Down 17.3% over 5 sessions and 10.2% over 20, -77% from the 52-week high, and about 30% under the $0.60 price of the $15M registered direct of 2026-09-25 (424B5). No usable option chain (the ATM legs are not two-sided) and no EDGAR reaction history in the baseline. My own Yahoo bars show the last four prints, report-day close against the prior close: Nov 2025 -10%, Feb 2026 -9.5% (then another -12% the next day), May 2026 -1.6% (it opened +7%), Aug 2026 +7% (on a Q2 revenue beat of $0.70M vs $0.54M). 20-day realised vol is 92% annualised and the deadband is 5.8%. Consensus is thin and of unknown age (Benzinga): Q3 revenue about $0.85M, Q4 about $2.1M, EPS -$0.06. With H1 revenue of $1.2M, that puts consensus FY26 at about $4.15M, the bottom of the company's $4-6M guide (given Feb, reaffirmed 2026-08-06). Coverage is mainly Canaccord (Buy, $2 PT as of May), which also ran the September deal. PEAK6 is down to 4.0% (13G/A, event date 2026-09-30). The company is barred from new issuance for 90 days from 2026-09-25 (until about late December). Shareholders approved a reverse split on 2026-09-09, and Nasdaq extended the bid-price deadline to 2027-04-12 (6-K of 2026-10-13).
view: The line this print trades on is the FY26 revenue guide of $4-6M, plus cash burn against the target of under $7M a quarter. The guide looks hard to hold. H1 revenue was $1.2M ($0.5M + $0.7M) and backlog was only $1.0M at June 30, so H2 needs $2.8-4.8M. In August management moved HiRain's China production start to 'the beginning of 2027' from the December 2026 date announced in Dec 2025. The September L3 win does not deliver until Q4 2027. The counter-drone and UGV radars launched in Sept/Oct are under evaluation, with no announced orders. A cut, or a guide at the bottom of the range resting on an unbacked Q4, is more likely than not. But consensus already sits at the bottom of the guide, which shows the analysts discount it. The stock trades near cash too: about $48M estimated after the raise, against a market cap of roughly $55-65M including the pre-funded warrants. It has fallen 17% into the print in what looks like tax-loss and deal-overhang selling, and the 90-day lock-up removes the near-term dilution fear. A burn number under $7M, or a Q3 revenue beat on a low $0.85M bar, could bounce it as Q2 did. Three of the last four reports closed down, two of them by about 10%, but the most recent was up. Net: a slight downside lean that I cannot separate from what the price and the low consensus already hold. No recommendation.

recommendation.reason: The guide is at risk: $1M backlog against an implied H2 of $2.8-4.8M, and the HiRain production start slipped to early 2027. But I cannot show the price fails to hold that. Consensus FY revenue already sits at the bottom of the guide, and the stock trades at an all-time low near cash after a 17% fall into the print. The direction probability does not reach 65.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A reaffirmed $4-6M guide backed by Q4 shipments or a backlog well above $1M (up), or a guide cut well below $4M together with a reverse-split ratio announcement (a bigger down move).

self_critique: The guide-cut story is visible to anyone who adds H1 to the backlog, and consensus already sits at the guide's bottom. A cut to about $3.5-4M may therefore be absorbed at a near-cash valuation, while burn under $7M and a Q3 beat on a low $0.85M bar could drive a squeeze-like bounce from an all-time low, as in August. Equally, this is a sub-$0.50 micro-cap with a negative reaction history and a possible reverse split, so the downside lean could be stronger than I hold.
